kitDescription: Aigis is an Iron SMG Supporter with a 20s Burst II cooldown whose kit is a pair of Persona-flavored buff packages plus a single burst nuke. From the start of battle she permanently buffs her own ATK and DEF by 21.12% each, with no expiry. When she personally casts her Burst Skill, she grants every ally (herself included) a flat ATK add equal to 21.12% of her own ATK, plus a matching DEF grant scaled off her DEF; both team buffs last until that Full Burst ends. Her Burst Skill itself is one instant hit dealing 396% of her final ATK as distributed damage to all enemies, landing just before Full Burst opens. In game terms she is a team-wide flat-ATK buffer whose contribution is the cast-gated ATK grant plus one moderate burst nuke per rotation, while her own SMG damage rides only her permanent self-buff.

redAssertions: S2 'window is BOUNDED' (s2Permanent/s2Short ally-sum bounds) — fails because aigis never casts behind crown in the blind fixture, so patching her S2 duration changes nothing
burst 'linear percent-of-final-ATK' (zero/shipped/doubled) — fails: no burst events exist to move her total
burst 'resolves BEFORE Full Burst opens' — fails: zero burst-bucket damage events from aigis
burst 'is Distributed-flavored' probe — fails: injected distributedDamagePct buff finds no distributed hit to feed
one further S2 assertion downstream of the empty own-cast event set (grant presence/shape family)

gotchas.summary: 'as long as this unit is still alive' clause is neither encoded nor recorded in unmodeled/caveats/note
gotchas.evidence: Prose: 'Activates when using Burst Skill as long as this unit is still alive.' Driver's override records nothing for it; S6 logged it as SKIPPED-AS-TRIVIAL, S5 declared it scope-trivial, both S2b reviewers called it scope-trivial (no death model at scope lock, so unconditionally true and damage-neutral)
gotchas.suggestedFix: Add one line to unmodeled.skill2 (or a caveat) noting the clause is scope-trivial in v1 (nobody dies at scope lock) — no mechanic to encode, just the audit record. No number, no fudge.

verdictRationale: The one real gotcha is a low-severity documentation nit: the alive clause is silently absent rather than recorded as scope-trivial (fix = one unmodeled line). Everything load-bearing is FAITHFUL and discriminating — the own-cast burstCast keying (the misread all three blind roles predicted) is pinned two ways, including the benched-behind-crown fixture where a fullBurstEnter model provably over-fires; the caster-scaled flat ATK basis is pinned against the target-scaled-atkPct trap; the FB-end window is a documented ⚑ derived from measured chain timing and pinned to real fullBurstEnd frames; the nuke's pre-FB/no-major/no-range boundaries are pinned against the fullBurstEnter counterfactual. Convergence reads RED only on the unmodified blind file, and every red is a blind-side fixture defect the second S2b reviewer predicted in advance: crown outranks aigis at stage 2 so she never casts, and the blind non-vacuity gate is satisfied by liter's casterAtkPct rather than hers (a blind-author bug); with the minimal repair that lets her cast, the blind suite is 11/11 green against the shipped override — genuine convergence on the model, not just the totals. The burstDesc 'allEnemies' dissent from the opus reviewer is overruled by the owner ruling plus the enforced census fixture, which per the prove-it-differently rule is the independent method — the bar is met and no further experiment is owed. The S6 defPct-on-allies proxy for Marakukaja was the weaker reading (wrong basis) and the driver correctly resolved it to verbatim-unmodeled. Same-model residual for the owner to spot-check: the 10.867s window is exact only for the plain 30f/22f/600f chain — any comp with a Full-Burst extender or a stalled chain makes the fixed durationSec drift from the kit's event condition, and every agent (driver included) shares the same chain-timing prior; the S6 measurement recipe (popup/banner read across the FB boundary on a focus recording) is the cheap independent check if that ever matters. For GO: ship as-is; optionally add the one-line alive-clause record.
